name: Orc
summary: In Durotar, orcs lead the Horde and seek honor after a long fall into demonic corruption. Once shamanistic clans on Draenor, they were deceived by the Burning Legion, invaded Azeroth, and were defeated and interned. Warchief Thrall led them back to their spiritual heritage and into a new home.

sections.title: Children of Draenor
sections.body: Across Draenor, orcs once roamed as nomadic hunter-gatherers in spiritual clans. They honored their ancestors and communed with elemental spirits, guided by revered shamans. Among their clans were the Frostwolves, Warsongs, and Shadowmoon. Orcs were physically formidable and proud, yet their society prized survival, honor, and harmony with the elements over conquest.

sections.title: Corruption and the Great Wars
sections.body:
Kil'jaeden and the warlock Gul'dan changed the orcs' fate through corruption. Deceived into drinking the blood of the demon Mannoroth, they fell to supernatural bloodlust. The original Horde nearly wiped out Draenor's draenei, then crossed the Dark Portal into Azeroth.

In the First and Second Wars, human kingdoms fell and orcish armies reached Lordaeron's gates. Treachery within their ranks and the united Alliance of Lordaeron defeated them, and survivors were driven into internment camps.

sections.title: A New Beginning in Kalimdor
sections.body:
As prisoners, the orcs lost their demonic frenzy and grew lethargic and broken. Thrall, raised in human captivity, escaped and returned to shamanism. He rallied the Frostwolf clan, freed his kin from the camps, and formed a renewed Horde. After receiving prophetic warnings, he led his people across the Great Sea to Kalimdor.

Grom Hellscream's sacrifice finally broke Mannoroth's blood curse. The orcs now live in Durotar, where they built the fortress-city of Orgrimmar. They strive to keep their hard-won honor amid renewed tensions with the Alliance.

faq.answer: No tale in Azeroth explains for certain why orcs are green. They have been green-skinned for as long as this world has known them. Every orc who came through the Dark Portal was green, and Thrall's orcs are green today.

faq.q: Where did the orcs come from?
faq.answer: The orcs came from Draenor, a world beyond Azeroth. They crossed through the Dark Portal after Gul'dan and the demon-possessed human sorcerer Medivh opened a rift between the worlds.

faq.q: Who is the leader of the orcs?
faq.answer: Warchief Thrall leads the orcs, and he is the son of Durotan. Humans raised him as a gladiator slave, but he rediscovered shamanism, freed the orc internment camps, and led the new Horde to Kalimdor.

The blood curse was the demonic enslavement that took hold when the orcs drank the blood of the annihilan Mannoroth. It filled them with uncontrollable bloodlust and drove their wars. Grom Hellscream gave his life to slay Mannoroth and finally break the curse.

faq.q: Why do the orcs live in Durotar?
faq.answer: After the Third War, Thrall settled the orcs in a harsh, dry coastal realm and named it Durotar for his father, Durotan. Its punishing terrain is penance for past sins and a trial that keeps his people strong and resilient.

faq.q: Are all orcs part of Thrall's Horde?
aliases: are all orcs friendly to horde
faq.answer: No. Thrall leads the New Horde, but rogue clans remain. The Dragonmaw clan still follows its enslaver traditions in the Wetlands, while the Blackrock clan under Rend Blackhand wages war from Blackrock Mountain and rejects Thrall's peace.
Orcs can train as warriors, hunters, rogues, shaman, mages, and warlocks.

angles.text: Orcs form the modern Horde's military and ideological backbone. They champion honor and survival alongside their troll, tauren, and Forsaken allies.
Alliance races still regard orcs with deep suspicion and resentment. They remember the slaughter of the First and Second Wars and the destruction of Stormwind.
For orcs, shamanism is more than magic. It is their reclaimed cultural soul and a path to spiritual redemption after decades of demonic servitude.
Orc warlocks face deep distrust and revulsion from their kin. Fel magic is the force that corrupted and enslaved their race.
